note: closed motion vocabulary. PageSpec node.motion.pattern must be one of these keys and reducedMotionFallback must equal the pattern's value (schema-enforced).

static.description: no motion on the section (hover colour transitions only)

reveal.fade-up.description: scroll reveal: keyframes fadeUp (opacity 0->1, translateY 1.25rem->0), 400ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1) forwards, paused until the observed root gets .is-visible once; stagger only via inline animation-delay

trigger.observedUnit: each [data-reveal-root]; all reveal targets inside it start together
trigger.observerDelayNote: IntersectionObserver v2 `delay` option (honoured by Chromium; ignored elsewhere)

stroke.draw-on.description: brush-stroke mask path stroke-dashoffset full->0 over 1s ease-in-out, then (same time) the fill fades 0->1 over 250ms standard; both only at >=768 (below 768 the stroke is static and fully drawn). The stroke mounts 800ms after DOMContentLoaded on a first page load (immediately on a client-side navigation). `load` strokes (page-opening headers) draw as soon as they mount; the others draw once when an IntersectionObserver on the section-sized shell reports threshold 0.9 (a section taller than viewport/0.9 can never reach it, so its stroke never draws and its fill stays hidden at >=768); S9 renders only below 768 (at >=768 the original's S9 box is clipped off-canvas); the opt-in `tall` trigger (used where the clone's placeholder copy makes a section taller than viewport/0.9 although the original's is not) draws once min(0.9 x section height, viewport height) is visible

stroke.idle.description: decorative stroke that never draws: full undashed path, no observer; the fill stays hidden at >=768 and is visible below 768 (features.tabs-dark default S6, editorial.community-bento S1, T4 heroes). It is decoration, not motion

stroke.still.description: stroke fully drawn and visible from the start: no dash style, no observer (the about hero S3 and the values dark grid S6 on the original)

marquee.loop.description: logo track translate(-2%) -> translate(-35.35%), 30s linear infinite, 3 copies of the logo set, no hover pause

carousel.autoplay.description: announcement slides step translateX(-n*100%) every 8000ms with a 500ms ease-in-out transition; clone slides at both ends, silent jump ~500ms after landing on a clone
carousel.autoplay.gap: the clone does not stop autoplay under prefers-reduced-motion (no rule in src/index.css or AnnouncementBar.jsx); generated pages SHOULD pause autoplay — recorded as a known gap, not enforced

slider.drag.description: hand-built slider: perPage 2 at >=1024 / 1 below, gap 1rem, 400ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1) track transition, draggable (50px threshold, not measured), no autoplay; controls only when slides overflow

tabs.instant.description: WAI-ARIA tabs, automatic activation; panels swap instantly (no transition, no autoplay)

nav.hide-on-scroll.description: sticky nav: inline top -navH when scrollY > top of the first <section> AND scrolling down; top 0 on any upward scroll; transition all 200ms standard

menu.popover.description: mega-menu opens on hover/click; mouseleave closes after 300ms; panel opacity 0->1 + translateY(-8px)->0 over 200ms ease-in-out, starting ~2 frames after the trigger state flips; switching triggers cross-fades

drawer.slide.description: mobile drawer, hamburger/close icons and bottom bar: opacity + translate 8px, 250ms standard

accordion.toggle.description: footer columns become accordions below 1024: content mounts instantly, chevron rotates 200ms standard

accordion.instant.description: FAQ accordion: each item opens and closes instantly (content mounts/unmounts, plus/minus glyph swap), items independent, aria-expanded + aria-controls; no height animation

accordion.height.description: partner-directory facet groups: group body height animates between its natural height and 0 over 350ms (CSS `transition: height .35s`, default ease)

sticky.pin.description: CSS position: sticky pinning, no animation: category bar top 0 (z 50, 1px bottom border once stuck), plan-matrix header top 0 (z 10, under the global nav at z 60), guide rail top 32, blog-rail promo top 0 and share bar bottom 0, form card top 32

scroll.progress-bar.description: fixed 6px top bar whose purple fill width is scrollY / (scrollHeight - innerHeight), written once per animation frame on scroll and resize; no CSS transition

scroll.spy-toc.description: guide table of contents: the active link is the last heading whose top is within 180px of the viewport top (recomputed every scroll frame); a click scrolls with a 1500ms cubic ease-in-out to 96px below the top and updates the hash; under reduced motion it jumps

scroll.linked-scale.description: champions hero: the outlines and the photo scale from 1 to 1.45 as scrollY goes 0 to 700 (scale = 1 + 0.45 * easeOutQuad), written per scroll frame with no CSS transition; not applied under reduced motion

marquee.photo-loop.description: event photo marquee: two identical sets of 14 photos translate 0 -> one set + one gap (-3528px, -4550px from 768) over 75.83s linear infinite; never pauses; off under reduced motion

dialog.scale-fade.description: developer-path dialog: the panel fades and scales .95 <-> 1 over 200ms ease-out on open (after one animation frame) AND on close (the leave runs before unmount); the overlay (ink-900 80% + 4px blur) has no transition; the dialog takes focus on open, <html> overflow is hidden while open, Tab is trapped, Escape and overlay click close, focus returns to the trigger

hover.lift.description: member card: translateY(-8px) and a two-layer shadow over 300ms standard on hover (rest: same shadows at alpha 0)

hover.chevron-shift.description: text link with a rotated 24px chevron (`shift`): the chevron translates 6px right on hover over 150ms standard (primitive.text-link; not a node-level pattern)

loading.skeleton-pulse.description: on-demand session grid: a filter change or a search edit (debounced 400ms) shows 3 pulsing skeleton cards (tailwind animate-pulse, #f3f4f6 blocks) for 1200ms before the filtered list appears
